methods.label: Share equally and count what remains
methods.explanation: \(7\div3=2\) with a remainder of 1. Giving each of the 3 schoolbags 2 books uses \(3\times2=6\) books and leaves \(7-6=1\). Since \(1<3\), this is a valid remainder. Write the quotient first, then the remainder: \(2,1\).
methods.levelReason: Equal sharing, multiplication facts and checking that the remainder is smaller than the divisor are primary-school procedures.
